summary: Miriam Dani lost in a whiteout on the Aspen-to-Crested Butte trek near the West Maroon Pass summit; sheltered overnight under a tree with a poncho, then hiked back to the Aspen trailhead Saturday morning
location: West Maroon Pass summit / Frigid Air Pass
responding_agency: Crested Butte SAR; Western State Colorado University SAR; Civil Air Patrol; Air National Guard
notes: Last seen ~4 p.m. Friday at the pass; 9 Crested Butte SAR + 4 WSCU SAR members searched from ~8:30 a.m. Saturday with CAP fixed-wing and ANG helicopter. Dani self-rescued, reached Aspen trailhead Sat afternoon, checked at Aspen hospital and released. Pass summit straddles the Gunnison/Pitkin line; recorded Gunnison per Crested Butte SAR response.
